text: Plumbing plans can pin native acceptance tests (#503). A native record names all of part, framework (go, pytest, vitest or jest) and an exact selector, beside its repository-relative file and a display label. Its identity is that tuple of part, framework, file and selector, never the label, and a plan's records are all native or all legacy. A native plan binds to a content digest of the trusted caller's captured repository contract and of the declared lockfiles and inputs of the parts running its tests. The captured commit is kept as provenance outside the hash, so an unrelated commit never invalidates a plan and changed policy always does, and a draft never supplies that authority. Sources are verbatim new regular files under tests/; builds run the ratified bytes, and a repository's line-ending normalization doesn't refuse them. Legacy Go plans, hashes and locks are unchanged. Execution adapters are pending, so native and configured drafts are refused before dependencies are prepared, and nothing qualifies without individual evidence. It extends D-0107's Go acceptance tests to each part's own framework.
